Try the core loop

1. Today → "Triage 1 →"
2. Give "Checker notification not received" a category
3. Release gate → the unclassified rule turns green and a waiver becomes possible

Classify it as Product defect instead and the Jira rule fails, because that signature has no Jira link.

Keys 1–7 switch views.

What this pass changed

• Type is IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono on a seven-step ramp — no sizes in between
• The muted ink was failing contrast at 4.1:1 and is now 6.8:1; anything dimmer is a stroke and may never carry text
• Status split into a mark step (lamps, bars) and a text step, replacing four hardcoded one-off reds
• Tables sit flush on the page; only panels get a plate, so the pages stopped reading as a stack of identical cards
• Keyboard focus rings exist at all now

The Design system artboard, bottom left, is the implementation source of truth: tokens with their measured contrast, the type ramp, control anatomy and the spacing scale — what the React + Tailwind build reads from.
